intro.background: 整园项目询盘和标准品询盘完全不同。客户发来的不是我要100个马克笔，而是我们在迪拜建一个12班幼儿园，预算20万美金。你需要问清：场地面积、班级数、年龄段、预算、时间节点、设计风格偏好。回复要专业、结构化，不要一上来就报价。
intro.desc: 掌握整园项目询盘的专业回复流程和英语表达。
tasks: 引导客户进入方案阶段

oneLiner.en: A project inquiry is not a price request — it is the start of a 3-month relationship.
oneLiner.cn: 项目询盘不是报价请求——它是3个月合作关系的开始。

vocab.ex: Thank you for your project inquiry.
What is the total site area?
How many classrooms do you need?
Which age group are the children?
Could you share your budget range?
When is your target opening date?
vocab.exCn: 您的目标开园日期是什么时候？

vocab.ex: Could you share the CAD layout plan?
Do you have any reference styles?

mistakes.wrong: Please tell me your budget and I will quote.
mistakes.right: Before quoting, could you share some project details — site area, number of classrooms, age group, and target opening date?
mistakes.cn: 错误：一上来就要预算报价。要先问清项目情况。

basic.en: Could you share the site area?
How many classrooms do you need?
What is the target opening date?
basic.cn: 目标开园日期是什么时候？

basic.en: Do you have a layout plan?
We will prepare a proposal within 3 days.

advanced.en: Thank you for your interest. Before we prepare a preliminary proposal, could you share the following: total site area, number of classrooms, age group, budget range, and target opening date?
advanced.cn: 感谢您的兴趣。在准备初步方案前，您能分享以下信息：总场地面积、班级数、年龄段、预算范围和目标开园日期？
advanced.from: Could you share the site area?

advanced.en: Once we receive your layout plan and reference style, our design team will produce a 3D concept rendering and detailed quotation within 5 working days.
advanced.cn: 收到您的布局图和参考风格后，我们设计团队5个工作日内出3D概念效果图和详细报价。
advanced.from: We will prepare a proposal within 3 days.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We are building a 12-classroom kindergarten in Dubai. We need furniture and playground equipment.
lines.cn: 我们在迪拜建一个12班幼儿园，需要家具和游乐设备。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Congratulations! Thank you for the inquiry. Could you share the total site area, age group, target opening date, and budget range? Do you have a layout plan?
lines.cn: 恭喜！感谢询盘。您能分享总场地面积、年龄段、目标开园日期和预算范围吗？有布局图吗？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Site is 3,000 sqm, kids 3-6, opening in September 2027. Budget around 200,000 USD. We have a CAD plan.
lines.cn: 场地3000平米，3-6岁，2027年9月开园，预算约20万美金。我们有CAD图。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect. Please send the CAD plan and any reference styles. Our design team will prepare a 3D concept and detailed quotation within 5 working days.
lines.cn: 太好了。请发CAD图和参考风格。我们设计团队5个工作日内出3D概念图和详细报价。

fillBlank.q: Do you have a CAD ____ plan?

scenario.q: A client emails about a 10-classroom kindergarten project. Write a professional reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: Dear [Client], Thank you for your inquiry about your 10-classroom kindergarten project. We are excited to work with you. To prepare a tailored proposal, could you please share: 1) total site area, 2) age group, 3) target opening date, 4) budget range, and 5) your CAD layout plan? Once received, our team will prepare a 3D concept and detailed quotation within 5 working days. Best regards, Quinn
scenario.cn: 尊敬的客户，感谢您对10班幼儿园项目的询盘。为准备定制方案，请分享：1）总场地面积，2）年龄段，3）目标开园日期，4）预算范围，5）CAD布局图。收到后我们团队5个工作日内出3D概念图和详细报价。此致，Quinn

culture.title: 项目制外贸的节奏
culture.content: 整园项目从询盘到签约通常2-4个月。不要指望一封邮件成交。你的目标是：第一次回复专业→客户愿意继续聊→出3D方案→报价→多轮谈判→签约。每次回复都要有明确的下一步动作和时间承诺。

rounds.ai: We are building a 12-classroom kindergarten in Dubai.
rounds.cn: 我们在迪拜建12班幼儿园。

rounds.ai: Site is 3000 sqm, opening in September. Budget around 200k USD.
rounds.cn: 场地3000平米，9月开园，预算约20万美金。

rounds.ai: Can you send us a price list first?
rounds.hint: 解释项目制，需要先看方案再报价。
